title: Toggling mic mute using keyboard shortcut when nothing is using the mic should show the indicator widget anyway
line: Muting the microphones with the shortcut now shows the muted microphone icon in the system tray until they are unmuted.
explanation: The microphone indicator in the system tray was created only while some app was recording and deleted as soon as none was. Muting every microphone with Meta+Mute (or the mic mute key) therefore showed the OSD for a moment and then left nothing in the tray to say the mics were muted. The change keeps the indicator shown whenever all microphones are muted, even with nothing recording, and only removes it when nothing records and the mics are not all muted; with no microphone at all it stays hidden.

commits.message:
microphone indicator: show it while all microphones are muted

The indicator only appeared while an app was recording, so muting the mics
with the shortcut left no sign of it in the tray. Keep it shown whenever all
microphones are muted, but not on systems that have no microphone at all.

BUG: 501782

media.caption: Master: microphone muted with Meta+Mute, nothing recording. No indicator in the tray.
With the fix: the muted microphone icon stays in the tray.
Master, whole screen a few seconds after Meta+Mute: nothing shows that the mic is muted.
With the fix, right after Meta+Mute: OSD plus the muted microphone icon in the tray.

reviews.text: Clean C++ change in MicrophoneIndicator::update() that keeps the muted microphone tray icon visible whenever all microphones are muted even with no recording apps active, matching the direction of plasma-pa!416. Adding the m_sourceModel->rowCount() > 0 guard fixes a real bug where systems without any microphone would permanently display a muted-microphone icon, and guarding toolTipForApps(apps) avoids hitting its non-empty assertion. Thoroughly verified across idle mute/unmute, active recording, and microphone removal cases.

Does what the retitled bug asks: the microphone SNI is now kept while all microphones are muted even with nothing recording, so Meta+Mute leaves a visible muted-mic icon, which is the same behaviour Nate proposes in plasma-pa!416. The rowCount() > 0 guard is a real improvement over that MR, since muted() returns true for an empty source list and would otherwise leave a stray 'Microphone Muted' icon on mic-less systems. The tooltip subtext is correctly blank when no app records, and the before/after tray screenshots and the regression notes (recording app, click to unmute, mic removal, no mic at startup) cover the relevant paths. Nitpicks only: the 'completely removed when microphone isn't in use' comment on setStatus is now slightly stale, and scrolling up on the muted icon unmutes and makes it vanish under the cursor.
